Provide $68 of liquidity to GoonFi's main pool on Solana and keep the position open. Budget: $68 deposit + $2.20 gas + 145 min over 60 days — expected net $2 ($1/hr), P10 net $0. Verdict THIN on the expected net. Cost: $68 of capital and $0.10 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Make one qualifying action each week on Solana, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote, so the wallet stays active. Cost: $0.10 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot — listed 75 days ago. Cost: the $68 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes; a claim costs about $0.10 of gas per chain ($0.10 across 1 chain), so never pay a third party to claim for you. Cost: $0.10 of gas to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction hash in a farm log under the slug "goonfi" so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Check the position on the Solana explorer: the protocol holds $5.2M across 1 chain — if TVL falls below $2.6M, reconsider the position. Expected net $2 at the $68 deposit, P10 net $0; verdict THIN. Cost: nothing but the check. Time: 10 minutes.
